categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in the photovoltaic (PV) industry, focusing on photovoltaic materials and products including backsheet materials, high-efficiency solar cells (notably n-type TOPCon cells), solar modules, and photovoltaic application systems such as distributed residential PV systems and commercial and ground-mounted power stations. It also engages in EPC (Engineering Procurement Construction) services for solar power projects and is expanding into energy storage and wind power projects.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced photovoltaic technologies including n-type TOPCon solar cells, with lab efficiencies reaching 26.99%. It has developed proprietary technologies such as JSIM 2.0 metalization to improve cell efficiency and reduce costs. Production methods include integrated product development (IPD) and 'make-to-order' manufacturing, supported by ERP, MES, and WMS systems for quality and inventory control. The company also innovates in PV module encapsulation, offering differentiated solutions like all-glass and lightweight flexible modules.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include PV module manufacturers, solar power project developers, and end-users of distributed solar power systems, primarily in residential, commercial, and industrial sectors. The company serves both domestic Chinese markets and international markets, with exports to over 60 countries and regions. It maintains strategic partnerships with central and state-owned enterprises and has a strong presence in European, Indian, and other global markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, covering 28 provinces and over 1100 counties for its residential distributed PV business. It also has manufacturing bases in Jiangsu and Shanxi provinces and subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Singapore, Indonesia, Europe (Luxembourg, Spain, Italy), and Australia. Overseas sales account for about 21% of revenue, with significant markets in Europe, India, and the Americas.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company is positioned in the midstream and downstream segments of the photovoltaic supply chain. It manufactures core PV materials such as backsheets and solar cells, assembles modules, and develops and operates PV application systems and power stations. It also provides EPC services, linking manufacturing with project development and operation.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing R&D in high-efficiency n-type solar cells (TOPCon and BC technologies), developing innovative PV module encapsulation solutions, and expanding PV application scenarios. The company emphasizes cost reduction, efficiency improvement, and market expansion. It collaborates with leading research institutions and universities domestically and internationally to maintain technological leadership and protect intellectual property with a growing patent portfolio.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of photovoltaic backsheets, solar cells, and modules, as well as sales of photovoltaic application systems. Additional revenue streams include EPC contracting services for solar and energy storage projects, and licensing or investment income from equity holdings. The company also receives government subsidies related to its operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position globally in photovoltaic backsheets, with the largest shipment volumes worldwide. It is recognized as a Tier 1 PV module manufacturer by Bloomberg New Energy Finance and has received multiple industry awards for innovation and quality. Competitors include other major PV material and module manufacturers in China and internationally, but the company differentiates itself through technology innovation and integrated application solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 6.1 billion, a 50% decline from the previous year, reflecting industry-wide price pressures and market challenges. It incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 856 million, reversing from profit in 2023. Total assets stood at RMB 16.6 billion with a slight decrease year-over-year. The company is actively managing costs and pursuing market expansion to recover growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, durable photovoltaic materials and high-efficiency solar cells with advanced technology such as n-type TOPCon and proprietary metalization processes. Its differentiated encapsulation solutions, including lightweight flexible modules and all-glass modules with superior environmental resistance, provide enhanced reliability and performance in diverse application scenarios. Strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent holdings, and integrated system solutions create competitive advantages and customer value.
